messages:
hanna: noticed strange p95 wobble for /v1/embeddings at 11:45 — dashboard shows spike only on route breakdown, not service-level.
sam: which aggregation did the panel use? t-digest rollups or raw samples?
hanna: the panel uses rollups. query: `SELECT pctile(0.95, latency_ms) FROM rollups WHERE route='/v1/embeddings' AND window='1m' GROUP BY origin, endpoint`
lee: ok quick theory: during the routing change we started tagging some requests with origin='' instead of origin='proxy' when fanout happened. t-digest merge treats empty-origin as the default bucket so high-latencies leaked into proxy bucket.
devops-bot: routing-change event recorded at 1708209950 by @sam, change id rc-2026.
console-bot: patch deployed to staging: panel added provenance breakdown (origin, retry flag) and small legend note. PR: #4622.
sam: does this affect billing or quota? billing-bot?
billing-bot: noticed small reconciliation mismatch for last 24h between quota counts and invoice ledger for routes that use origin in quota-key.
hanna: from quick sample: p50 unchanged, p95 up 80-150ms depending on endpoint, p99 jitter larger but low sample. suggests tail mixing not full distribution shift.
lee: suggested fixes: (A) change ingestion to default origin='edge-proxy' when missing, (B) make rollup merge treat empty-string as its own key (no contamination), (C) add UI toggle to show percentiles excluding retries and excluding missing-origin samples.
sam: short-term: (1) update dashboard to show both filtered and unfiltered p95 for product owners, (2) add alert to warn when >1% of samples have missing origin.
hanna: long-term: enforce origin invariant at edge and add unit test for t-digest merge with missing keys.
lee: also adding an integration test to billing pipeline to ensure quota keys with missing origin are not silently aggregated.
console-bot: dashboard change pushed to prod in canary (region us-west-2).
devops-bot: rolling back routing tweak for rc-2026 in us-east-1 to stop further contamination.
sam: I'll own ingestion fix; plan: set fallback origin and add telemetry to count missing-origin incidents. target: next Thursday.
hanna: pls also add a short note in the runbook about interpreting percentiles when provenance mix changes.
sam: will do. closing when ingestion patch merged and dashboard shows both views.
